title: Become the Light That Illumines the Path

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a lovely event that was. And my
sisters were as elegant as ever. I wish to
stand side by side with them on that stage
as soon as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro meet and greet was a roaring
success. On the way back, Mejiro Bright
and I find ourselves basking in the
afterglow of the
event.

text_block_list.name: Event Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
Today's meet and greet was great and all,
but to be honest, I'm not sure about
Bright
and Dober. I haven't heard much about
them.

text_block_list.name: Event Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
This is just what I've heard,
but apparently
their running could use some work. The
Mejiro family's hyping them up as future
stars, but I dunno...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know Bright isn't usually the type to
let a
little criticism get to her.
Even so, today
seems to be a little different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I have no choice but to achieve an
exemplary result at the tryouts. I
must
show everyone a run that will live up to
their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This is my duty as an Umamusume of the
Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh... This is where we first met. Hehe,
that's right. We watched that
tree
together, side by side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? That leaf...
I see it finally fell to the
ground. What a shame. It
held on for so
long, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...My! I spot a bud... It's a little one,
but it's
definitely there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the leaf we watched together has
fallen, new life has already begun to take
its place.
If it can fend off the remaining
whispers of winter, then it'll surely bud
brilliantly in the coming spring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is. Soon...
spring will come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always been moving forward by
herself, at her own pace. My advice
helped her evolve—only because she had
already laid down
the groundwork.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My spring... Is it truly...
just around the
corner?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Can I become just like my sisters?
Can I
finally join their ranks as a
proud Mejiro?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Relative A
text_block_list.text:
Bright? Unfortunately, she has a rather
delicate build... It's a shame,
but racing
will likely prove difficult for her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan has a gift for running! She'll make
waves in the scene for sure.
Hm? As for
Bright...
you watch from the sides for now.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright, what were you—oh, were you
watching us run again? You
should just run
with us next time!

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Ryan. Can I...
Can I become like you and
the others someday?

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I dunno what you mean by
"like us," but you can be
whatever you
wanna be!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: So come on—let's run together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I finally understand. Back then, when I
was staring at that leaf... I
must've been
waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall present you with a victory at
tomorrow's tryouts. And then, I'll
make my
debut!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
It looks like today's race is full of
slow starters. I'm guessing
they'll save their
gas for the final stretch,
which means we're in for a long one.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro Bright is here, too. And she's acting as carefree as ever... I wonder how she'll do. It'll all come down to the timing of her final approach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Provisional Trainer, I've finished my
warm-up. Do you have any words
for me
today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This race will likely come down to a
battle of patience over when to
accelerate in the
final stretch. Worrying too much about
your time and losing your pace means
putting yourself at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All I need to do is wait for my
opportunity and seize it. Just like we
practiced.
...Still,
can I really win this race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her acceleration might be a tad slow, but
her running itself is a cut
above the rest.
As long as she times her final spurt
correctly, she won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee, thank you. I promise to live up to
your expectations of me...
and achieve
victory!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And our racers are out of the gates! 1,800
meters of turf, six
racers—all proceeding
along at a slow and steady pace!

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text: ...H-hey, this is more than just slow and steady... Someone, anyone... hurry up and take the lead!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Haha... this is kinda funny. Aren't they going way too slow?

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I can't take this! I'm a little early,
but here I go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(...There's nothing to fear.
I only need to
keep my pace and wait for
an opportunity.
And once it's my turn to blossom...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(...I can hear your voice,
just like when we
practiced. My time to
blossom... has
come!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Our racers have reached the final stretch!
They're all speeding up—What's this?!
From the very back of the pack, Mejiro
Bright flies
forward!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, bear witness! I shall show you
the might of the Mejiro
family—of its
newest light!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright has convincingly won the
tryouts race! But before I have
time to
bask in her victory...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I-it took her two minutes?! To run 1,800
meters?! That's way too slow,
at least ten
seconds behind the average!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Well,
this is worse than I expected.
Who's going to want to train someone who
took two whole minutes to run 1,800
meters?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry, I saw it. I saw your
strength... and your determination. I
need
to make sure I don't fall behind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've returned,
Provisional Trainer... Look, I
won the race as I promised!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure,
her time was slow. But her ability to
surge forward in the final
stretch is a talent
that'll surely be applicable even in the
highest echelon of races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she can perfect that skill,
then her future looks bright. As I think
that, I find myself
curious about her future racing career,
and the road that she'll walk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer. I look forward to
working with you from today
onwards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming for faraway heights—the summit
of the racing world.
However, those peaks
are too bright for me to face alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is why...
I would like you to guide me
there. Please, will you join
me in
welcoming the spring?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I'm so happy. Yaaay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I've teamed up with Mejiro Bright
to compete in the Twinkle
Series, where
she can reach new and greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hooray. Woo... I've finally... debuted. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...How long are you planning to stand
there? If you're going to be Bright's
trainer,
then you have to learn when to cut
her off, or you won't make any progress.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, sorry to interrupt, but if you're
going to be Bright's trainer,
then you
should learn when to cut her off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! ♪
